sampleOnly: Illustrative actual measured widths from MAPGEN R6 context; heights are TEST FIXTURES, not certified current physical bounds; CHL producer must measure own rigs
mandatoryRoute: EVERY advertised supported rig must complete required checkpoints via one physically driveable route, no required optional shortcut, no unavoidable fall/penalty due to width alone
optionalRoute: Optional narrow bridge may serve Light; Heavy must retain an equivalent scoring-eligible main route. Geometric width acceptance is necessary, NOT sufficient for physical completion
finish: Exactly one Completed emission per run and only after all checkpoints crossed in order
retries: Retry clears index/elapsed/trigger dedup, increments generation; old collision callbacks ignored; no rewards or economy side effects
inputScope: DESIGN ACCEPTANCE: does not implement Unity course, PhysX Rigidbody movement, trigger handlers, host adapter or rewards
